redline.description: Transcribe ALL printed text of the document in reading order, exactly as printed (keep printed misspellings), and mark every handwritten markup inline using CriticMarkup: {~~printed words~>handwritten replacement~~} when handwriting replaces struck-through or marked printed words; {--printed words--} for printed words struck through with no replacement; {++handwritten words++} for handwriting inserted (caret, leader line, or written in a gap); {>>margin note, gloss or proofreading mark such as sp, cap, lc, paragraph<<} placed directly after the printed words it refers to. A struck-through word must stay inside the markup, never silently dropped. Copy handwriting verbatim with its spelling; write [?] for unreadable characters. Do not correct anything that is not marked. Underlining alone is a comment, not a deletion.

changes.description: One entry per CriticMarkup tag in redline, same order.

printed_text.description: The printed words struck through, replaced, or commented on. Empty for a pure insertion.

handwritten_text.description: Verbatim handwriting. Empty for a pure deletion.

anchor.description: 3-6 printed words around the change, so a reviewer can find it.

needs_review.description: true if the handwriting is hard to read, the span of the strike is unclear, or it is unclear what the mark refers to.
